_note: 5.0 engine output for IMG_4809 / orange #20 (answers; 7 discovery sightings attached), images removed. Evaluation fixture, not training data.

denominators.visiblePctOfAnalysed: (confirmed + likely) / analysed match time (camera on play)
denominators.note: Percentages of the recording are not percentages of the player's playing time.

physical.reason: No validated pitch calibration for this recording; values are development estimates.

distanceObserved.method: uncalibrated: camera-motion-compensated image motion scaled by an assumed 1.8 m player height (pinhole depth from box height, damped); single moving camera, no pitch calibration
distanceObserved.note: Distance while validly observed only - not total match distance.

workRate.method: uncalibrated: camera-motion-compensated image motion scaled by an assumed 1.8 m player height (pinhole depth from box height, damped); single moving camera, no pitch calibration

peakSpeed.method: uncalibrated: camera-motion-compensated image motion scaled by an assumed 1.8 m player height (pinhole depth from box height, damped); single moving camera, no pitch calibration
peakSpeed.note: Maximum of the same smoothed speed series used for sprint peaks.

sprintCount.method: uncalibrated: camera-motion-compensated image motion scaled by an assumed 1.8 m player height (pinhole depth from box height, damped); single moving camera, no pitch calibration

highSpeedRunCount.method: uncalibrated: camera-motion-compensated image motion scaled by an assumed 1.8 m player height (pinhole depth from box height, damped); single moving camera, no pitch calibration

sprintDistance.method: uncalibrated: camera-motion-compensated image motion scaled by an assumed 1.8 m player height (pinhole depth from box height, damped); single moving camera, no pitch calibration

ball.note: Ball detections are frequently missed for far-away play; counts are lower bounds and have not been validated against labelled events. Duel/tackle candidates need review and are never counted as statistics.

heatmap.reason: No validated pitch calibration covers the player's visible time.

offball.method: image-plane distance to the nearest opponent / team-mate, in the target's body heights, on confirmed frames only

sequences.reason: opponents not visible near you for most of the sequence
opponents not visible near you for most of the sequence
